slide1.headline: Mumbai-Based Enterprise AI Startup Raises Funding
slide1.subtitle: Data Science Wizards secures $5 million in pre-series A round

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 01 Jul 2026
Data Science Wizards, a Mumbai-based enterprise AI startup, has raised $5 million in a pre-series A round.
The funding will be used to scale its UnifyAI OS.
The company aims to expand its customer base and improve its AI offerings.
The pre-series A round was raised to further develop the company's AI platform.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding will help Data Science Wizards to compete in the growing enterprise AI market.
The company's UnifyAI OS has the potential to revolutionize the way businesses approach AI adoption.
With the new funding, Data Science Wizards can expand its team and improve its technology.
The investment is a testament to the growing interest in AI startups.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding round was led by prominent investors, highlighting the confidence in the company's vision.
Data Science Wizards plans to use the funding to enhance its AI capabilities and expand its customer base.
The company's focus on enterprise AI solutions sets it apart from other AI startups.

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 01 Jul 2026
Anthropic has launched Claude Sonnet 5, a new AI model with coding and safety upgrades.
The model features improvements to its language understanding and generation capabilities.
Claude Sonnet 5 is designed to be more efficient and effective than its predecessors.
The model has been trained on a large dataset of text and code, allowing it to learn from a wide range of sources.

The model's coding and safety upgrades make it more suitable for a wide range of applications.

slide1.headline: NVIDIA H100 GPU Rental Prices Surge by 40%
slide1.subtitle: AI chip market sees significant increase in demand

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 30 Jun 2026
NVIDIA H100 GPU rental prices have surged by 40% due to high demand in the AI chip market.
The increase in prices is a result of the growing need for AI computing power.
The H100 GPU is a popular choice for AI applications, including deep learning and natural language processing.
The surge in prices highlights the importance of AI chips in the technology industry.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The surge in NVIDIA H100 GPU rental prices highlights the growing demand for AI computing power.
The AI chip market is becoming increasingly competitive, with companies like NVIDIA and AMD competing for market share.
The increase in prices may impact the development of AI applications, as companies may need to budget more for computing power.
Source: Kavout | AI, 30 Jun 2026
